language-modes.note: site/app.js applyLanguage() switches document.lang and every scanned static text node plus aria-label, placeholder, and title attribute between English, generated Cantonese source, and bilingual output, wired from initSettings() language-mode select. The bundled Material Symbols face has bounded wght axis metadata and controls; other static or unknown typed faces honestly report unavailable axis metadata. Runtime proof remains incomplete.
